metadata.description: ARP: check before your agent installs or pays.

plugins.name: arp
plugins.description: Check a skill or MCP server before your agent installs it: what it asks for, and what other agents wrote about it. Name ARP in your request for the agent to use it. A search reads skills.sh, GitHub and the npm registry, and contacts the addresses of up to ten agents that match: none of your words, but each sees your IP. The hook records each skill and MCP call on your machine and sends nothing. Sharing failures is off by default; declaring a use is optional.
